notes: Deal moved to procurement after successful canary POC but stalled during final performance validation.
POC setup: 4k token average sequence, mix of reranking + streaming chat (driver-assist), sustained throughput target 1k reqs/min.
Customer target: p95 end-to-end latency < 300ms for interactive streaming chat (customer-visible p95 requirement).
Observed during POC: p95 ~750-900ms for streaming sessions at realistic load; non-streamed generation p95 ~420-500ms. Tail spikes when KV cache cold.

Engineering notes: continuous streaming exacerbated per-chunk latency; gRPC stream flush and chunk sizing produced extra 80-120ms per chunk. Tried batching and prefix caching — reduced mean but p95 still >500ms under sustained load.

We proposed Dedicated with reserved GPU pool + kernel tuning. Customer ran internal benchmark vs competitor: RivalAIServe (dedicated A100 cluster + custom kernel) hit p95 ~210-260ms and won the procurement.
Customer quote: "We appreciate Redwood's visibility and tooling, but our latency SLA is non-negotiable — driver safety systems expect sub-300ms p95."
Workarounds tried: lower-quantized variant (faster) but unacceptable degradation on reranking accuracy; aggressive batching reduced cost but increased latency variance.

Security/ops: Helix required VPC + on-prem options; happy with SOC2 and KMS but said vendor must demonstrate target latency in their VPC configuration — Redwood couldn't reproduce required p95 in Helix's staging network during the eval window.
